description: An Agent JWT minted by Python asap.auth.agent_jwt.create_agent_jwt from test-only keys derived from fixed labels, a fixed clock, and a fixed jti. tests/auth/test_agent_jwt_interop_vector.py proves Python mints and accepts it; @asap-protocol/client verifyAgentJwt must accept it at the same clock. The token expired long ago; it is not a credential.
